effects.text: The Dying creature may immediately speak up to twenty words (fifty from CL 10) in a language it knows — no spells, abilities or actions. It is not Stabilised.

system.description:
AUDITORY CANTRIP SOUL UTILITY
Tradition divinity
Cast R (verbal)
Trigger: A willing living creature within 30 feet gains the Dying condition
Range 30 feet
Targets the triggering creature

You briefly hold the target at the threshold of consciousness, allowing them to speak despite their condition.
The target may immediately speak up to twenty words. They can speak only languages they normally know and cannot use this opportunity to Cast a Spell, activate an ability or perform another action.
The spell does not Stabilise the creature, alter its Dying condition or prevent death.

Caster Level Modifications:
CL 5: Increase the range to 60 feet.
CL 10: The target may speak up to fifty words.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. A Reaction cantrip: the card says how many words.
